verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe snapshots as point-in-time captures of sandbox filesystem/state that can be created from images/Dockerfiles and used to create new sandboxes, including cold/hot snapshot types and warm pools built from snapshots, and CLI/SDK support snapshot lifecycle management for creating new sandboxes from them. Missing for 10: explicit hands-on independent confirmation of restoring/forking multiple sandboxes from one snapshot.
